title: Rihanna Reveals the Product A$AP Rocky Keeps Stealing From Her: ‘That Bottle Just Is Empty Right Now’
summary: The Fenty mogul also shared the beauty ritual she hopes to learn from daughter Rocki someday.
contentText:
Rihanna may be a billionaire beauty mogul, but she still never seems to have enough body wash — and it seems as if A$AP Rocky is to blame.

Related

Watch Rihanna Fangirl Over ‘Love Island USA’ Winner Trinity Tatum at A$AP Rocky’s Paris Concert

Rihanna Uses Some Fenty Math to Reveal She Has ‘At Least’ 170 Unreleased Songs in the Vault

Rihanna Is ‘in the Studio Right Now’ & She’s ‘Cooking,’ Teases A$AP Rocky

When asked by The Cut at a Fenty Beauty event which of her products her partner steals the most, Ri turned serious. “Every time I go into the shower, somehow my body wash — vanilla flowers, that one in particular — is just going down by a quarter of the bottle,” she said in a clip posted Wednesday (Oct. 28).

“I remember how many pumps I had,” she continued. “I know exactly where the bottle was at. And somehow, that bottle just is empty right now.”

She then stared pointedly into the camera. (Rocky, she’s on to you!)

Also at the event, Ri turned a question about which beauty rituals she’s excited to pass down to her daughter, Rocki — whom she and the rapper welcomed in September last year — on its head. “I’m looking forward to Rocki passing up beauty rituals to me,” the 14-time Billboard Hot 100 -topping artist said. “She is like a skin goddess. Her skin is so perfect. The elasticity, always moisturized, perfect complexion. These are the things that we want.”

The quick chat with Ri comes as Fenty is about to celebrate its 10-year anniversary, meaning it’s been a full decade since the star launched her game-changing business with a line of foundations that came in a radically diverse number of shades. The brand is now launching a new foundation formula, which the singer-mogul told The Cut stays perfectly airbrushed onto her face, even when she’s sweatily trying to “wrangle all three of my kids.”

And though it’s been just as long since she dropped an album (2016’s Anti) that she’s been building her beauty empire, Rocky recently teased that his partner is hard at work in the studio.

“Yo, she in the studio right now,” he revealed in August on The Jason Lee Show . “Yeah, I said it. Sorry, babe. Like, bro, she working. She cooking, no funny s–t. Damn, I’ma get in trouble for this.”
